Q5217.reason: Costco's confirmation was expressly conditional on the loading charge, so it is a counteroffer that Rainmaking never accepted, and with no performance there is no contract.

Q8260.reason: Water is formed directly when the electron transport chain reduces O2 at its end, so it stops immediately, while glycolysis and pyruvate production continue briefly without oxygen.

Q5585.reason: A lay witness may estimate a vehicle's speed if shown adequate opportunity to observe and enough experience to make the estimate, so the objection should be overruled on that foundation.
